== Build notes ==
The numbered white-on-black printing is from [[File:Decipher-Virtual-Set-1a-numbered.pdf|Virtual Set #1a]]. It is separate from the numbered black-on-white option and the earlier unnumbered sheet. The two numbered options have the same text and values; their Dark Side ink differs. The metadata creation date and printed tournament-legality date are recorded separately.

The article uses the matching publisher slip only. Uncovered lore, destiny, type and uniqueness were checked against the underlying printed Decipher face. No matching full-card reconstruction was substituted and no new gameplay ID was assigned. Existing family articles and identifiers remain intact; reciprocal Versions links include this publication.
